test: Deliberate reproduction of 'Updated from your tax profile' reopen behaviour
platform: macOS 26.6.2 arm64, NSH desktop host, scratch db, agent + by-hand UI clicks

mechanism.trigger: Opening a stored Draft after the tax profile changed. crates/bir-app-api/src/screen_form_module.rs open path calls follow_profile(kind, draft, from_profile): every profile-bound field the filer did not edit on that return (tracked in the draft's profile_baseline) is set to the current profile value, the result is SAVED quietly, and the page shows 'Updated from your tax profile: <field> <old> → <new>' listing what moved.
mechanism.edited_boxes: If the filer edited the profile boxes on the return, follow skips them; the page instead shows 'Differs from your profile: <field> <draft> (profile <new>)' plus a 'Use profile values' link. Clicking it calls screen_form_use_profile and applies profile values to every unedited profile box; it also re-ties the boxes to the profile, so the NEXT reopen follows again.
mechanism.fields_overwritten: Only profile-bound draft paths: rdo_code, taxpayer/buyer name, registered address, zip, phone, email, and baseline-tracked fact fields (birth date, taxpayer_classification, line_of_business). Observed moving: 'Contact Number 09051234567 → 09059876543' (2550Q); 'Buyer's and seller's RDO Codes 047 → 050', buyer name, registered address, email (1606); address, email, 'RDO 050 → 039' (2551Q).
mechanism.user_told: Yes — a banner at the top of the form page lists each moved field ('Updated from your tax profile: …'); the quiet save marks the draft 'Saved'.

schedule_data.1606: Schedule-1 property fields (tct_number, tax_dec, location, area, FMVs — stored as flat draft fields) intact on screen and in data_json after both the 'Differs' reopen and a full auto-follow reopen.
schedule_data.2551Q: schedule_1 Vec (6 rows incl. PT010 + 5 rows @11,111.11, total 333.33) intact on screen and in data_json after auto-follow reopen.
schedule_data.2550Q: part_iv items (31A 1,234,567.89 etc.) and schedule_2 amounts intact on screen and in data_json after auto-follow reopen.
schedule_data.screen_vs_saved: In every repro on this build the rows were lost NEITHER on screen NOR in storage. The original incident (1606 draft in forms-n3.db, fix session): the stored data_json still holds every schedule field, so at minimum the saved data was never lost there either — the emptied state was screen-side or transient, not a durable clobber.
schedule_data.permanence: The follow's quiet save persists only the profile-followed values (by design). No path in follow_profile/with_profile_values/agent::compute writes schedule fields, so a subsequent Save cannot make row loss permanent unless the screen itself had dropped them.
